metadata.description: Magician Hub: builds, PRs, Jira and time for the Magicians team in one page

plugins.name: magician-hub
plugins.description: Runs Magician Hub on your PC (http://localhost:4545): your builds, team PRs with real review status, Jira tickets, time logs, standup, release notes and impact check, with popups. Uses your existing Git login; no tokens to configure.
